channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Mamdani admin names Transportation Dept. new senior staffers
item.description: Having campaigned on "fast and free buses" — and getting sworn in at a disused, historic subway station — Mayor Mamdani is seeking to make transit improvements a cornerstone of his mayoralty.

item.title: Mamdani admin confident state will grant NYC more money in budget
item.description: The mayor has been pushing Gov. Hochul to hike taxes on the wealthiest New Yorkers and corporations, as well as arguing more generally that the city doesn't get an equitable share of the pie and that the state should give the Big Apple more funding.

item.title: Netflix buys Ben Affleck’s AI company that’s geared toward filmmakers
item.description: Netflix purchased Ben Affleck's Interpositive company, which utilizes AI tools to assist filmmakers. Terms of the acquisition weren't announced.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for March 06, 2026
item.description: Fresh courage stirs as the day begins. While romantic Venus waltzes into Aries at 5:45 am EST, we're nudged to prioritize warmth, openness, and choices that honor our values. item.title: Former NYC Council member Ronnie Eldridge dies at 95
item.description: Ronnie Eldridge, an outspoken Manhattan activist and local television host, who served on the City Council for 22 years, died Thursday. She was 91.

item.title: Ballerina Farm influencer Hannah Neeleman announces 9th baby
item.description: Ballerina Farm influencers Hannah and Daniel Neeleman announced the birth of their ninth baby Thursday. The couple has had six girls in a row.

item.title: Officer injured by thrown object trying to arrest suspect at Bronx subway station
item.description: The cop suffered a minor laceration after he was struck by an unknown object at the Fordham Road subway station around 5:24 p.m., according to law enforcement officials.

item.title: Nets’ turnover problems haunt them again against Heat in 10th straight loss
item.description: The Nets had their chance to reset in Miami. Instead, the same problem followed them into Thursday night's rematch.
